Softlemon API Documentation

Postman collection → OpenAPI spec →

Introduction

Base URL: https://softlemon.ddev.site 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

You can retrieve your token by visiting your dashboard and clicking Generate API token.

Authentication

Register Merchant

POST
https://softlemon.ddev.site
/api/register/merchant

Register a new merchant user.

Headers

Content-Type
Example:
application/json
Accept
Example:
application/json

Body Parameters

name
string
required

Merchant username.

Example:
architecto
email
string
required

Merchant email. Must be a valid email.

Example:
merchant@example.com
password
string
required

Merchant user password.

Example:
|]|{+-
merchant_name
required

string required Merchant name.

Example:
architecto
mcc
string
required

Merchant 4-digit MCC code.

Example:
5999
terms_accepted
boolean
required

Must be accepted.

Example:
true
Headers
:
:
Body
{ "name": "architecto", "email": "merchant@example.com", "password": "|]|{+-", "merchant_name": "architecto", "mcc": "5999", "terms_accepted": true }
Request failed with error

Tip: Check that you're properly connected to the network. If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS. You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Received response

Example request: 
curl --request POST \
    "https://softlemon.ddev.site/api/register/merchant" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"name\": \"architecto\",
    \"email\": \"merchant@example.com\",
    \"password\": \"|]|{+-\",
    \"merchant_name\": \"architecto\",
    \"mcc\": \"5999\",
    \"terms_accepted\": true
}"

const url = new URL(
    "https://softlemon.ddev.site/api/register/merchant"
);

const headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "name": "architecto",
    "email": "merchant@example.com",
    "password": "|]|{+-",
    "merchant_name": "architecto",
    "mcc": "5999",
    "terms_accepted": true
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$url = 'https://softlemon.ddev.site/api/register/merchant';
$response = $client->post(
    $url,
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'name' => 'architecto',
            'email' => 'merchant@example.com',
            'password' => '|]|{+-',
            'merchant_name' => 'architecto',
            'mcc' => '5999',
            'terms_accepted' => true,
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));
Example response:
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Merchant registered successfully. Please complete verification.",
    "code": "",
    "data": {
        "user_id": 13,
        "merchant_id": 17
    }
}
{
    "success": false,
    "message": "Validation error",
    "code": "ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED",
    "data": null,
    "errors": {
        "name": [
            "The name field is required."
        ],
        "email": [
            "The email has already been taken."
        ]
    }
}

Self-Service API Keys

Generate Own Merchant API Key

POST
https://softlemon.ddev.site
/api/my/merchant/api-keys
requires authentication

Generate an API key for the authenticated user's own merchant.

Headers

Authorization
Example:
Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}
Content-Type
Example:
application/json
Accept
Example:
application/json

Body Parameters

name
string
required

API key name.

Example:
architecto
expires_at
string

API key expiration date. Must be a date in ISO 8601 format.

Example:
2026-12-31
ip_addresses
object[]

List of IP address objects that will be whitelisted for this API key.

address
string
required

Valid IP address to Whitelist.

Example:
198.51.100.5
description
string

IP address description.

Example:
Eius et animi quos velit et.
Auth
:
Bearer
Headers
:
:
Body
{ "name": "architecto", "expires_at": "2026-12-31", "ip_addresses": [ { "address": "198.51.100.5", "description": "Eius et animi quos velit et." } ] }
